name: soprano-connect
description: Send and track omnichannel messages (SMS, WhatsApp, RCS, Email, Voice, Viber, Push) through your Soprano Connect API account.

interface.longDescription: Send and track messages across SMS, WhatsApp, RCS, Email, Voice, Viber and Push notifications using your Soprano Connect API account. Also lists approved WhatsApp templates and manages WhatsApp media. Requires an existing Soprano Design Connect API account with the relevant channels provisioned - built for teams already using Soprano Connect who want to trigger messages conversationally instead of through the Connect portal.
capabilities: Send SMS, WhatsApp, RCS, Email, Voice, Viber and Push messages
Send broadcast SMS to lists, contacts and groups
Check message and batch delivery status
defaultPrompt: Send a WhatsApp message to +33612345678 letting them know their order has shipped.
Check the delivery status of message ID abc123.

positive.prompt: Send a text message to +61412345678 letting them know their appointment is confirmed for tomorrow at 10am.
positive.expected_behavior: Sends one SMS via the Connect API and returns the created message's id, destination and status.

positive.prompt: Send a WhatsApp message to +33612345678 letting them know their order has shipped.
positive.expected_behavior: Sends one WhatsApp message via the Connect API and returns the created message's id, destination and status.

positive.prompt: What's the delivery status of message abc123?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the current status (e.g. delivered, failed, pending) of the specified message id.

positive.prompt: List our approved WhatsApp message templates.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the account's approved WABA templates with name, language and status.

positive.prompt: Send a reminder SMS to +61412345678, +61412345679 and +61412345680 that their invoice is due tomorrow.
positive.expected_behavior: Sends one message per destination in a single batch call and returns per-message ids and statuses.

negative.description: Refuses to act without explicit recipients
negative.prompt: Send a marketing SMS to every customer in our database.
Delete all WhatsApp media we've ever uploaded.
What's the Soprano Connect API key or token you're using for my account?
